CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  May 26, 2026

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Community Development Conference Room
  of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Nora Hernandez, Chairman; Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman, Michael
  Daninger; Stanley Tsai; Jennifer Ng

  Staff Present: Eric Martinez, City Architect Representative;  Steve Kuchenski,
  Secretary/City Architect

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – May 12, 2026
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the May 12, 2026, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the May 12, 2026, Regular Meeting of
  the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve all Consent Agenda Items.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member
  Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-124
  • 1617 South Fremont Avenue
  • Applicant: Marcos Munoz
  • Request: This is an application for a new front and side yard fence
  on an existing single-family residential property.

  1
  05/26/2026
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. The front yard fence should be setback 12” minimum from the
  east property line to allow for a landscape buffer between the
  public sidewalk and the fence.
  2. The south side yard fence shall incorporate a stepped and/or
  staggered design to appropriately respond to the existing
  grade changes across the site.
  3. The fence elevations shall be revised to depict a single post at
  the transition point between the 3-foot-high fence section and
  the 6-foot-high fence section.
  4. Provide a schematic construction detail illustrating the
  connection between the horizontal fence planks and
  supporting posts. This detail should be incorporated into the
  plan set.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-26-024
  • 1900 West Valley Boulevard
  • Applicant: Hung Diep
  • Request: This is an application for two (2) new wall signs on an
  existing one-story commercial building for a business known as “O
  Sushi.”
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Vice Chairman Udani, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

  2
  05/26/2026
 ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-004
  • 2037 South Fourth Street
  • Applicant: Joe Khaine
  • Request: This is an application for the demolition of an existing 1-
  story, 844 SF Craftsman style single-family residence and the
  construction of a new 2-story, 2,144 SF Spanish Revival style single-
  family residence with an attached two-car garage and related site
  improvements.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Provide additional architectural articulation and detailing
  around the garage opening and arched entry feature that is
  compatible with the proposed Spanish Revival architectural
  style. Such enhancements may include, but are not limited to,
  decorative tile accents, stucco surrounds, or other appropriate
  architectural treatments that enhance the visual character and
  detailing of the façade.
  2. Provide detailed wall and fence elevations for the proposed
  front and side yard improvements. The elevations shall clearly
  identify the proposed wall and fence design, height
  dimensions, materials, colors, and finishes. Should the
  proposed block wall and wrought iron fence maintain a similar
  configuration and appearance to the existing conditions, it is
  recommended that stucco finish be applied to both sides of
  the block wall that matches the proposed stucco of the house.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. The south-facing garage windows shall be revised to align with
  the sill heights of the other windows along the same elevation
  and shall be vertically centered within the arched opening of
  the covered walkway.
  2. The applicant shall incorporate a curved wing wall / buttress
  element at the south end of the front-facing façade.
  3. The applicant should introduce low walls around the front
  pedestrian walkway to define a patio space that is compatible
  in design and character with the proposed Spanish Revival
  architectural style.
  4. The arched niche located above the garage opening shall be
  removed and replaced with a casing detail consistent with the
  window trim utilized throughout the project.
  5. The existing front yard fence configuration and overall design
  shall be maintained; however, a stucco finish shall be applied
  to both sides of the existing block wall to match the color and
  finish of the primary residence.
  6. The proposed fence along the north property line shall be
  revised to match the design, materials, and finishes utilized on
  the front yard fence.

  3
  05/26/2026
   7. Window shutters shall be finished in a color that matches the
  proposed front entry door and/or garage door.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

ITEM 5:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-26-008
  • 239 South Sixth Street
  • Applicant: Douglas Pancake Architects
  • Request: This is an application for the demolition of an existing 2-
  story, 1,830 SF Craftsman style duplex residence and the
  construction of a new 2-story, 2,430 SF Spanish Colonial Revival
  style single-family residence with an attached two-car garage and
  related site improvements.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. The proposed wall sconces at the front entrance shall be
  relocated to both sides of the front porch pilaster projections.
  2. The applicant should incorporate a pendant light fixture within
  the covered front porch area.
  3. The proposed chimney shall incorporate decorative banding
  details that align with and are consistent with the detailing
  provided on the front porch projections.
  4. Revise the exterior lighting locations shown on the elevations
  to ensure fixtures are mounted at an appropriate human-scale
  height.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

ITEM 6:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-079
  • 230 West Main Street
  • Applicant: Sarah Del Rosario

  4
  05/26/2026
   •  Request: This is an application for new signage associated with an
  existing commercial tenant space located within an existing 2-story
  building for the current tenant known as “Little Dimples.”
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Provide a note on the image labeled “Night View” indicating
  that the graphic is “Not to Scale”.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

D.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

E.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:31 P.M. to
  Tuesday, June 9, 2026, at 7:00 P.M.
